Theorem
[Perelman's spherical $\kappa $-solution] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0115 ↗ def:chow-iii-kappa-solution 1. ch19:19.36\group Spherical Construction

For every $n\ge 3$ there is a rotationally symmetric, reflection-invariant, Type II $\kappa $-solution on $S^n$ which shrinks to a round point in forward time. Its backward limits include the Bryant soliton and the shrinking round cylinder.
